# Teque Hub - AI & Software Engineering Agency

## About
Teque Hub is a premier software engineering firm specializing in:
- Cross-Platform Mobile Development (Flutter, React Native)
- Business Automation (n8n, Zapier, Custom Workflows)
- AI Integration & AI Agents
- Web Development (Next.js, React, Node.js)

We help businesses automate workflows, build custom software, and integrate AI to improve efficiency.

## Core Services
- **Mobile Development**: High-performance iOS and Android apps.
- **Web Development**: Scalable, modern web applications.
- **AI & Automation**: Custom AI agents, workflow automation, and LLM integration.
- **App Maintenance**: Long-term support and updates.
